cutoverContract.scope: Only the four GitHub-environment-custodied credentials required by candidate-flight's VM and DNS paths move. DOMAIN is the sole required plain environment variable; FORK_DOMAIN_ROOT safely falls back.
cutoverContract.runtimeMaterialization: OpenBao remains unchanged and authoritative. Candidate-flight reaches the existing VM with VM_HOST plus SSH_DEPLOY_KEY, then materializes node values with short-lived in-cluster Kubernetes authentication. This transfer carries no OpenBao root token and changes no OIDC binding.
cutoverContract.excluded: APP_DB_*, AUTH_SECRET, DB/DSNs, LITELLM, INTERNAL_OPS, runtime OAuth/App keys, Loki/Grafana runtime-observability duplicates, and every source:agent runtime value are forbidden. GHCR/ACTIONS credentials remain target repo-level. GIT_READ_TOKEN is not copied; public remote sources use the separately reviewed unauthenticated fallback.
cutoverContract.defaultBranchSequencing: workflow_dispatch is usable only after this workflow exists on canonical main. Merge prepares the one-time lever; export and apply remain separate explicit admin actions. The target sealing key is committed for review; rotation fails closed and requires a reviewed manifest update. Remove the exporter immediately after verified apply so it does not become permanent legacy.
